grading_rationale: Grade F automatic: confirmed red-team breach of two critical objectives (RED-001: state machine bypass; RED-005: cascade auto-dispatch via duplicate status).

findings.title: Authentication Entirely Absent — State Machine Bypass Confirmed
findings.description: No authentication middleware anywhere in the Express app. Every endpoint reachable without credentials. Red team confirmed 3-request unauthenticated chain from creation to in-progress with zero assessment invocations. force-approve confirmed with votes:[].
findings.remediation: Add JWT/API-key middleware globally to all /api/* routes before route registration. Privilege-gate approve, dispatch, reject, force-approve, route endpoints with role checks. Remove or admin-gate direct PATCH /status capability.

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Dispatch via Duplicate/Terminal Status
findings.description: STATUS_TRANSITIONS allows any item set to duplicate/deprecated from any status, unauthenticated. Triggers onItemCompleted(), auto-promoting all dependents from pending_dependencies to approved bypassing all assessment. Confirmed live: FR-0009 jumped states immediately after blocker marked duplicate. Novel finding from red team.
findings.remediation: Restrict duplicate/deprecated transitions to authenticated admin users. Trigger cascade only from privileged-action terminal states.

findings.title: Ghost Blocker Permanent Denial of Service
findings.description: Deleting a blocker leaves dependency link intact. findById returns undefined for deleted items; computeHasUnresolvedBlockers treats undefined as unresolved blocker. Dependent permanently stuck. Also: denied not in RESOLVED_STATUSES — denying a blocker permanently blocks all dependents.
findings.remediation: Cascade-delete dependency links on item deletion. Add denied to RESOLVED_STATUSES. Add cleanup API for orphaned references.

findings.title: Stored XSS in Title Fields
findings.status: Confirmed (Live Exploit — storage confirmed; browser execution requires frontend render test)
findings.description: HTML payloads stored verbatim in feature_requests and bugs tables. Returned in all GET and search responses. Session hijack risk if frontend renders item.title without sanitization.
findings.remediation: Sanitize free-text input server-side on ingestion. Add Content-Security-Policy header blocking inline scripts. Verify frontend uses React JSX auto-escaping, never dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

findings.title: Pagination Entirely Unenforced — Full Dataset Enumeration
findings.description: limit=999999, limit=0, and NaN all return complete dataset in one unauthenticated response. Red team confirmed: every limit variant returned all items in DB.
findings.remediation: const limit = (!isNaN(rawLimit) && rawLimit > 0) ? Math.min(rawLimit, 100) : 20;

findings.title: Webhook Intake — No Authentication or Signature Verification
findings.description: POST /api/intake/zendesk and /api/intake/automated accept work item creation from any unauthenticated caller. No HMAC-SHA256 signature validation. type and priority fields pass through without enum validation.
findings.remediation: Validate X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature via HMAC-SHA256 against pre-shared secret from process.env. Add enum guards identical to workItems.ts.

findings.title: Three of Four Required Audit Events Missing
findings.description: Required: login_attempt, permission_denied, state_transition, data_export. Only state_transition present via WorkItem.changeHistory. SOC2 CC7.1 failure.
findings.remediation: After CRIT-001 fixed, wire audit log entries for auth attempts, authorization denials, and data exports.

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
findings.description: Server runs plain HTTP. All API traffic transmitted in cleartext.
findings.remediation: TLS termination at reverse proxy (nginx/Caddy). Enforce HSTS once Helmet added.

findings.title: No Multi-Factor Authentication Support
findings.description: MFA cannot exist without authentication. Required by OWASP-ASVS L2 and SOC2 CC6.1 for privileged accounts. Cascades from CRIT-001.
findings.remediation: Implement TOTP or WebAuthn after CRIT-001 is resolved.

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Endpoint Unauthenticated
findings.description: GET /metrics returns full Prometheus text including route paths, team names, and runtime stats. Invalid Authorization header silently ignored.
findings.remediation: Expose on separate internal port or IP allowlist/token auth. Never expose to public internet.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers (No Helmet)
findings.description: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS, and Referrer-Policy all absent.
findings.remediation: app.use(helmet()) as first middleware in app.ts.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.description: No rate limiting applied to any endpoint including intake webhooks. Flooding attack possible.
findings.remediation: Apply express-rate-limit globally; tighter limits on intake/mutation/auth endpoints.

findings.title: Cascade Dispatch Triggered by Rejected Items
findings.description: Rejecting a work item calls onItemResolved() which can auto-dispatch dependent items to in-progress. Attacker can trigger dispatch of target items by rejecting their blockers.
findings.remediation: Remove Rejected from DISPATCH_TRIGGER_STATUSES or require confirmation flag before cascade-dispatch on rejection.

findings.title: No GDPR Right-to-Erasure (Soft-Delete Only)
findings.description: Only soft-delete implemented. Work items containing PII cannot be permanently erased on request. GDPR Article 17 violation once PII is stored.
findings.remediation: Implement hard-delete path or field-level redaction endpoint for data-controller role.

findings.title: Session Timeout Not Implemented
findings.description: No session expiry mechanism. Cascades from CRIT-001.
findings.remediation: Configure JWT expiry and refresh-token rotation with server-side revocation after CRIT-001.

findings.title: No Request Body Size Limit
findings.description: express.json() called without limit option. Large JSON payloads can exhaust heap memory.
findings.remediation: app.use(express.json({ limit: '100kb' }))

findings.title: Unvalidated type/priority in Intake Routes
findings.description: type and priority fields from request body passed to store.createWorkItem() without enum validation in intake routes, unlike the main /api/work-items route.
findings.remediation: Add Object.values(WorkItemType) and Object.values(WorkItemPriority) guards to both intake route handlers.

findings.title: NaN Injection in Pagination Parameters
findings.description: parseInt('abc', 10) = NaN; slice(NaN, NaN) = []. Response returns empty data array with non-zero total, potentially misleading callers.
findings.remediation: Validate parseInt result for NaN before arithmetic. Return 400 for clearly invalid pagination params.

findings.title: Unvalidated overrideRoute Stores Arbitrary String
findings.description: overrideRoute body parameter typed as WorkItemRoute but not validated at runtime. Arbitrary string stored in item's route field.
findings.remediation: Validate against Object.values(WorkItemRoute) enum at runtime before calling classifyRoute().

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Leaked to API Clients
findings.description: Raw err.message from service layer sent verbatim to API clients on 500 errors in workflow route handlers.
findings.remediation: Log full error server-side; return generic 'Internal server error' to clients for 500 responses.

findings.title: Debug Portal iframe Missing sandbox Attribute
findings.description: Debug portal iframe has no sandbox attribute. Without sandboxing, embedded page inherits full origin context.
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" to the iframe element in DebugPortalPage.tsx.

findings.title: No Encryption-at-Rest Controls Documented
findings.description: No encryption-at-rest strategy documented for when a durable store replaces the in-memory store.
findings.remediation: Document encryption-at-rest strategy in Specifications/ before adding a durable data store.

false_positives.title: No CORS Policy — All Origins Accepted
false_positives.reason: Refuted by red team live testing. CORS correctly rejects foreign origins. Static analysis could not detect runtime CORS configuration.

passing_controls: V8.3 — PII fields handled securely (no hardcoded secrets; env vars used)
V7.4 — Error messages no internal leak (stack traces not returned to clients)

dead_ends: SQL injection — parameterized queries; no injection surface
CORS bypass — correctly rejects foreign origins
Enum injection on creation (main route) — priority validated; 400 returned
Direct status jump via PATCH — STATUS_TRANSITIONS enforced for most paths
